description: Fades one pair of audio inputs down under another pair whenever that other pair makes a sound, in mono or stereo

params.text: Sets how hard the over signal pushes the under signal down, 0 for no ducking at all and 2 for the hardest; the setting is squared before it multiplies the detected level
Sets how slowly the ducking lets go once the over signal falls away, as a time constant from 0 to 1 second

inputs.text: The left channel of the audio that takes priority; the louder of the two over channels drives the ducking, and this signal crossfades into the left output
The right channel of the audio that takes priority; the louder of the two over channels drives the ducking, and this signal crossfades into the right output
The left channel of the audio pushed down, which crossfades out of the left output as the ducking deepens
The right channel of the audio pushed down, which crossfades out of the right output as the ducking deepens

outputs.text: Crossfades between the left under input and the left over input, moving towards the over input as the ducking deepens
Crossfades between the right under input and the right over input, moving towards the over input as the ducking deepens

notes: nothing is normalled between the two sides; a mono source patched to the left OVER and left UNDER inputs comes back at the left output, and the right output stays at 0V
shift-dragging up or down on the module name changes the colour of the panel, and holding ctrl as well makes the change finer
